fullContentHtml:
AIBE 22nd Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

AIBE 22nd Online Form 2026. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 27 October 2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 19 August 2026
  • Last Date : 27 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 October 2026
  • Form Correction Last Date : 30 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 29 November 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 14 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 3500/-
  • SC, ST, PwBD : Rs. 2500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

What is AIBE 22nd Online Form 2026?

AIBE 22nd Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 27 October 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://www.allindiabarexamination.com/

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
